name: The wearable computer
alt: Photo of the working prototype on a table: Raspberry Pi 4 wired by a ribbon cable to a breadboard of keys, display glasses, folding keyboard and power bank.
blurb: A Raspberry Pi in a sling, display glasses and earbuds. Your agents, your wallet and your notes, worn rather than opened.

name: Push-to-talk
alt: Concept render of a woman wearing display glasses and the sling, pressing the orange talk key while she speaks.
blurb: Hold the talk key, speak, release. Your words become text and go to your agents; the answer comes back in your ears and as a line in your glasses.

name: On-command camera and memos
alt: Photo of the tiny camera clip board with its lens and a glowing red recording light.
blurb: A clip-on camera and a memo button. Photos, clips and voice notes only when you press, with a red light facing outward while it's on.

name: The Argo dashboard
alt: Screenshot of the dark kiosk dashboard on its Sensors panel: deck, camera clip and Hermes status tiles.
blurb: Talk, agents, approvals, transactions, wallets and more, in your glasses. Switch panels by voice, by a button or with keys 1 to 9.

name: Agents you own
alt: Screenshot of the kiosk Agents panel: a kanban board with researcher, librarian, wallet and portfolio tasks.
blurb: Six open-source Hermes agents on your own server: a librarian, a researcher, wallet, trader and portfolio agents, and a builder. They share a kanban board, not your keys.

name: Agent Safe and cold storage
alt: Photo of the bare Raspberry Pi Zero board that becomes the offline cold key.
blurb: The agents work from a capped Safe smart account. Your savings sit with a cold key that never goes online and owns everything, including the power to cut the agent off.

name: The Transaction Guardian
alt: Screenshot of the kiosk Transactions panel listing executed, refused and waiting transactions with the Guardian's reasons.
blurb: Every proposed transaction is simulated against live Ethereum state, checked against rules the agent can't see, and approved onchain for that exact transaction only. A Chainlink CRE workflow, in simulation today.

name: The approve key
alt: Concept render of a fingertip about to press the green-lit approve keyswitch on the chest panel.
blurb: A lit mechanical keyswitch on the deck. It blinks when a checked transaction is waiting; you hear what it does, then press once. Hold it with the mic key to freeze the wallet.

name: Every chain call through NOWNodes
alt: Screenshot of the kiosk Wallets panel with balances read from the chain for the hot, savings and cold wallets.
blurb: Simulation, broadcast and balances on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Polygon through one NOWNodes key, with more than 100 networks behind it.

name: Your second brain
alt: Screenshot of the kiosk Media panel: a grid of photos, clips and memos with their backup status.
blurb: Memos, photos and notes are filed into a plain-markdown second brain your agents can read and answer from. Notes stop being write-only.

name: Open source, your own server
alt: Concept render: exploded drawing of the kit, the Pi case, remote panel, camera clip, glasses case and strap.
blurb: MIT-licensed, on GitHub: the deck, the Guardian, the Safe module and the wiring guide. Your agents run on your server, with the models you choose.
